title: Core comparison morphism and termwise annihilation
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-push-pull, the pushforward is coherent and there exist a comparison morphism from G to its completion and an exponent t >= 1 such that the ideal power K^t annihilates the kernels and cokernels of every component.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 088B and Remark 0888

proof.text: Coherence gives quasi-coherence and finite type of F. The finite-pushforward theorem applied to the identity gives finite affine sections. Noetherianity upgrades these to finite presentation; the affine criterion and locality give finite presentation of F. Proper higher direct image in degree zero is finitely presented. Transport across its canonical isomorphism to pushforward, and apply the coherence criterion to prove coherence of f_*F.
Take the existing tensor-pullback adjunction, and construct kappa and alpha with their quotient and adjunction equations.

Apply affine annihilation to the constructed maps and their equations. Condition (2) of the existing four-way annihilation equivalence implies condition (1), giving one positive exponent killing every component kernel and cokernel. Package h, alpha and the exponent.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 088B: coherence from existing proper-image finiteness, comparison construction and affine completed-base support argument split into two statements; Remark 0888 (2) implies (1), implemented by Q1.

theorem exists_formalSystemsPushPull_core {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J K : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (_hV : IsIso (pullback.snd f (Scheme.Opens.ι K.support.compl)))
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X)
    (_β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj) :
    ∃ h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj),
      ∃ α : G ⟶ (completion Y J).obj
          ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩,
        ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
          IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
            (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
            (kernel (α.hom.app (op n)))) ∧
          IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
            (Scheme.idealSheafPower K.toModulesι t).2
            (cokernel (α.hom.app (op n))))
